title: Location of the right edge marker
statement: For every natural number $R$ and integer $z$, the guide tape of radius $R$ carries the right edge marker at coordinate $z$ if and only if $z=R+1$.
replaced:
For every radius $R$ and every integer coordinate $z$, the guide tape of radius $R$
carries the right edge marker at $z$ if and only if $z = R + 1$.
